# Engines

**Generated by `scripts/gen_engines.py` — do not edit by hand.**
`tests/test_engines_doc.py` fails if this file drifts from the code,
or if an engine reads an option that has no description here.

## At a glance

| Engine | Binary | Auth | Timeout | Targets | Category |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `httpx` | `httpx` | **no** | 300s | web, api, cloud, host, container | service probing / fingerprint |
| `katana` | `katana` | **no** | 600s | web, api, cloud | crawler / attack-surface discovery |
| `zap` | `` | **no** | 1800s | web, api, graphql | full DAST (crawl + active scan) |
| `nuclei` | `nuclei` | yes | 900s | web, api, cloud, kubernetes, container, host | multi (full templates + dast fuzzing) |
| `wapiti` | `wapiti` | yes | 1500s | web, api | web DAST (per-vuln modules) |
| `nikto` | `nikto` | **no** | 900s | web, host, container | web server misconfig |
| `dalfox` | `dalfox` | yes | 900s | web, api | XSS |
| `sqlmap` *(opt-in)* | `sqlmap` | yes | 1200s | web, api | SQL injection (confirm/exploit) |
| `testssl` | `testssl.sh` | **no** | 600s | web, api, graphql, cloud, host, container | TLS / transport security |
| `schemathesis` | `schemathesis` | yes | 1200s | api, graphql | API property-based fuzzing |
| `graphw00f` | `graphw00f` | **no** | 180s | graphql | GraphQL fingerprint |
| `graphql-cop` | `graphql-cop` | yes | 300s | graphql | GraphQL security audit |
| `kube-hunter` | `kube-hunter` | **no** | 900s | kubernetes | kubernetes cluster pentest |

**Auth = no** means credentials are not passed to that engine: it scans anonymously,
finds a fraction of what an authenticated run would, and reports that as a normal result.
The engine has no header flag we have verified. Run `yubel engines` to see the same column
for your installation.

## Target routing

| Target type | Engines | Opt-in |
|---|---|---|
| `web` | `httpx`, `katana`, `zap`, `nuclei`, `wapiti`, `nikto`, `dalfox`, `testssl` | `sqlmap` |
| `api` | `httpx`, `katana`, `zap`, `nuclei`, `wapiti`, `dalfox`, `testssl`, `schemathesis` | `sqlmap` |
| `graphql` | `zap`, `testssl`, `schemathesis`, `graphw00f`, `graphql-cop` | — |
| `grpc` | **none** | — |
| `kubernetes` | `nuclei`, `kube-hunter` | — |
| `container` | `httpx`, `nuclei`, `nikto`, `testssl` | — |
| `cloud` | `httpx`, `katana`, `nuclei`, `testssl` | — |
| `host` | `httpx`, `nuclei`, `nikto`, `testssl` | — |

A target type with no engine is a config error, not an empty report.

## Options every engine accepts

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `keep_workdir` | false | Keep the engine's temporary directory instead of deleting it. The only way to inspect a tool's raw output when a run reports `error` — this is the debug switch. |
| `timeout` | engine's `default_timeout` | Seconds before the engine is killed and its run recorded as `timeout`. Applies to every engine. |

## Per-engine options

### `katana`

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `depth` | 2 | Crawl depth. |
| `headless` | false | Use a headless browser — needed for SPAs, requires Chrome/Chromium. |
| `js_crawl` | true | Parse JavaScript for endpoints (`-jc`). |
| `known_files` | true | Fetch robots.txt / sitemap.xml. |

### `zap`

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `ajax` | false | Enable the AJAX spider for JS-heavy apps. |
| `api_format` | openapi | Spec format for `zap-api-scan.py`. |
| `mode` | baseline | `baseline` runs ZAP's passive spider and is the default; `full` runs `zap-full-scan.py`, which **actively attacks** the target. Any other value is a config error rather than a silent fallback. |

### `nuclei`

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `dast` | true | Run the parameter-fuzzing (DAST) pass. Disabling both falls back to the full pass. |
| `extra_args` | — | Extra nuclei flags, as a list or a shell-style string. |
| `full` | true | Run the full-template pass. |
| `offline` | false | Air-gapped mode: no OAST/interactsh, no template update check. |
| `rate_limit` | nuclei's default | Requests per second cap (`-rl`). |
| `severity` | low,medium,high,critical | Comma-separated nuclei severities to keep. Note that `info` is **not** included by default — pass `info,low,medium,high,critical` to keep it. |

### `wapiti`

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `depth` | wapiti's default | Crawl depth. |
| `scope` | folder | `page`, `folder`, `domain` or `url`. |

### `nikto`

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `maxtime` | 600 | Wall-clock cap in seconds passed to nikto itself. Always sent; set it to 0 to drop the cap. |
| `tuning` | — | Nikto tuning string, e.g. `x6` to skip DoS checks. |

### `dalfox`

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `max_urls` | 25 | How many crawled URLs to test. dalfox is invoked once per URL, so this bounds the run. |

### `sqlmap`

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | — | POST body to test, as sqlmap's `--data`. |
| `level` | 1 | sqlmap test level 1-5. Higher is slower and more intrusive. |
| `risk` | 1 | sqlmap risk 1-3. Higher may modify data. |

### `testssl`

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `severity` | LOW | Minimum severity testssl.sh reports. |

### `schemathesis`

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | target's url | Override the base URL the spec is tested against. |
| `examples` | 50 | How many test cases schemathesis generates per operation (`--hypothesis-max-examples`). It is a count, not a switch. |

### `kube-hunter`

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `active` | false | Enable active (intrusive) cluster checks. |

## Top-level config keys

| Key | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `parallelism` | 4 | Max engines running at once. |
| `engines` | all | Allow-list of engine names. An unknown name is a config error, not a silent no-op. |
| `disable` | — | Deny-list of engine names. |
| `include_opt_in` | false | Allow intrusive engines (`sqlmap`). |
| `crawl` | true | Feed crawler-discovered URLs to the parameter scanners. |
| `crawl_max_urls` | 150 | Cap on discovered URLs seeded per target. The cap is logged, never a silent truncation. |
| `chains` | true | Synthesize attack chains. |
| `cluster_threshold` | 8 | Collapse this many similar info/low findings into one. |
| `baseline` | — | Prior `yubel.json` to diff against. |
| `fail_on` | — | Exit non-zero at or above this severity. |
| `fail_on_new` | false | With `baseline`, gate only on new/regressed. |
| `offline` | false | Air-gapped hardening. Today this reaches **nuclei only** (no OAST/interactsh, no template update check); the other engines ignore it. |
| `output.dir` | yubel-report | Where reports are written. |
| `output.formats` | json, html, markdown | Reporters to run (`md` is an alias for `markdown`). |
| `output.sarif` | true | Also emit `yubel.sarif`. |

Two per-target keys are parsed and then **ignored**: `scope` and `exclude` are read into
`Target.scope` / `Target.exclude`, and no engine consults them — so a config that sets
them is not scoped in any way. They are accepted rather than rejected only because
rejecting would break existing files; treat them as not implemented.

## Authentication

`Auth.kind` is one of `bearer`, `cookie`, `header` or `basic`, and extra headers ride
along with any of them — `--bearer X --header "Y: Z"` sends both. Every engine with
**Auth = yes** above receives all four kinds through one shared implementation
(`Engine.auth_headers`), so a new adapter gets them by declaring `header_flag`.

`form` and `oauth2` appear in the `Auth` dataclass but no engine implements them.

Declaring the flag is not sufficient: the *spelling* has to match too. Most tools take
`-H 'Name: value'`; graphql-cop parses its `-H` with `json.loads()` and wants `-H '{"Name": "value"}'`. An adapter states which it is via `header_style`, because
graphql-cop reacts to a header it cannot parse by printing one line and carrying on —
so getting it wrong drops the credentials without failing the run.
